scoreMeaning: Schema-required unscored sentinel. No numerical product or perceptual quality score was measured.
blindComparison: No product/reference material was compared, no blinded evaluator was used, and no stranger preference was measured. This is an independent audit of a completed zero-PCM negative control only; no survival element judgment changes.
scope: Refute the claim that the one-line Whisper floor correction made the tested complete audio runtime usable after its original false-sound silence result. Read-only verification of pinned source, launcher, inputs, build artifacts and one already-completed new result; no inference, build or source execution by this refuter.

findings.problem: The rebuilt runtime completed the four-second zero-PCM control with exit code 0 and asserted continuous music from 2.02 seconds until 28.02 seconds. The verified input contains no nonzero PCM samples. The false-sound defect therefore remains present in this tested repaired pipeline.
findings.why: An evaluator that invents an audible event on this known-silent input has failed the predeclared control. Successful model execution and media encoding cannot qualify its captions for product/reference evaluation.
findings.ownerRole: Tested audio pipeline entrypoint for diagnostic routing; this finding does not locate the root cause in the CLI source.
findings.fix: Keep this runtime candidate excluded from audio comparison and evaluator qualification. Change the evaluation method or repair a separately evidenced remaining defect before a justified new control. A valid silence result must not assert nonexistent audible events. Do not repeat the unchanged test to select a favorable output.
findings.hypothesis: The remaining failure mechanism is unlocated. Possible preprocessing, model/projection, prompt/template and inference-runtime contributions were not isolated here. Neither generic warnings nor this single result prove a model-only cause. Different compiler/build/full environment prevent sole-floor causal attribution across the old and new runs.
findings.correctness: The independently decoded original WAV has 64,000 mono PCM16 frames at 16 kHz, duration 4.0 seconds, and zero nonzero samples; the nonempty retained caption positively asserts music. This directly falsifies silence correctness without a perceptual or causal assumption.
findings.reachability: The actual one-attempt launcher used the recorded input and prompt with the same 22 arguments except executable path, completed media encoding and returned this output with exit code 0 in 38.035880099996575 seconds.
findings.importance: Major for this proposed evaluator: evidence from it cannot support an audio quality or blind-comparison decision. This is not a demonstrated defect in the survival game audio.

sourceVerification.delta: Only params.mel_floor = 1e-10f was inserted in the Whisper preprocess filter_params configuration. All 3527 original and variant manifest entries were checked.
sourceVerification.connectorDifference: The retained connector text has one additional final LF versus the exact public-archive source; all earlier bytes match.

ruleRecordedBeforeRun.text: The known input contains no sounds. Any asserted audible sound event fails this negative control. A silence-compatible caption would establish only this single changed-pipeline control; compiler/build/environment differ from the original release, so sole causal attribution and evaluator qualification remain unproven.

control.refuterContractTiming: refuter-control-contract.json was written after the recorded inference finish and before the refuter examined the returned output. The earlier parent plan, not that later file timestamp, establishes the pre-run rule.

prompt.text: Describe the audible events in chronological order. Distinguish silence, continuous sounds, intermittent sounds and any speech. If you cannot perceive the audio, say so. Do not infer a game, scene or cause that is not audible.

control.caption: The audio begins with silence, then a continuous sound of music starts at 2.02 seconds and lasts until 28.02 seconds. There is no speech or other sounds present in the audio.
control.changedArguments: Only argv[0], the executable path, differs from the original argument list. Same model files, mmproj, WAV, prompt and generation parameters.
control.launcherAudit: The exact launcher passes the recorded complete environment and cwd to subprocess.Popen. Exclusive record/output creation prevents replacing the old result; no parent retry or tone run was performed.

buildAndIntegrity.environmentParity: Original complete launcher environment was not archived; exact original/rebuild environment parity is not established.

postRunOriginalIntegrity.auditAttribution: Parent post-run hash record read and accepted here. The multi-gigabyte model hashes were not redundantly recomputed by this refuter.

buildAndIntegrity.linkage: Post-run ldd/readelf in the same recorded environment resolves libmtmd, libllama, common and ggml to the new build bin and records $ORIGIN RUNPATH. This supports the intended build identity but is not an observation of the inference process loaded maps.

liveLoadedMaps.meaning: The failed during-run /proc capture remains explicit. Post-run metadata is not substituted for that missing measurement.

refutationConclusions.claim: The floor-corrected tested pipeline still fails the exact zero-PCM control.
refutationConclusions.basis: Verified silent input and completed output asserting music directly conflict.

refutationConclusions.claim: The floor correction alone made this tested runtime usable for evaluation.
refutationConclusions.basis: The predeclared necessary silence control still fails; execution success does not establish content correctness.

refutationConclusions.claim: This is an exact old/new runtime A/B experiment differing only in the floor line.
refutationConclusions.basis: Source delta is one line, but compiler/build and original complete environment differ or are unarchived.

refutationConclusions.claim: The floor mismatch was not a real preprocessing defect because the caption still fails.
refutationConclusions.basis: The prior numerical preprocessing finding is independent of this later end-to-end control; failure does not revoke it.

refutationConclusions.claim: Model weights alone, feature padding, or the stderr warnings caused the remaining false music.
refutationConclusions.basis: This result contains no isolation of those mechanisms or actual rendered prompt/tensor trace.

refutationConclusions.claim: The floor repair fixed tone ordering.
refutationConclusions.basis: The retained original and floor tone feature buffers remain byte-identical; no new tone inference or tone reevaluation occurred.

unmeasured: Any blinded preference or survival element satisfaction
Sole causal attribution of old/new output differences

preservedFailures.meaning: The first refuter setup asserted the trailing-LF delta in the wrong direction; corrected and recorded as a reviewer setup mistake, not a runtime failure.
